overview: The Climate Equity Council met to approve past minutes, schedule upcoming meetings, and review autumn community events. The Council also received an update on the city's curbside composting program and discussed outreach planning for winter preparedness and household hazardous waste disposal.

items.title: Review of June Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the June meeting.

items.title: Next Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Scheduled the next Council meeting for October 21, 2026, with the final start time to be determined via email.

items.title: Upcoming Autumn Events
items.summary: Reviewed logistics and translation needs for several upcoming community events, including the Housing Resource Fair, Hispanic Heritage celebrations, and the Junk in the Trunk swap event.

items.title: City Composting Program Update
items.summary: Received an update on Medford's Garbage to Garden curbside composting program and brainstormed school and community outreach strategies to increase enrollment ahead of the July trash schedule switch.

items.title: Waste and Battery Disposal Q&A
items.summary: Discussed safety protocols for disposing of lithium-ion batteries and other hazardous household wastes, such as swollen gas canisters, with staff offering to coordinate disposal answers with the DPW.

items.title: Future Agenda Planning and Winter Preparedness
items.summary: Planned future meeting topics focused on visual education campaigns for winter heating safety, utility bill assistance resources, and home winterization strategies.
